import { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { TutorialPanelContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
export interface TutorialPanelProps extends TutorialPanelContract {
    helpContent?: ReactNode;
    delegateRestoration?: boolean;
    startActionVisible?: boolean;
    children?: ReactNode;
}
export declare function TutorialPanel({ tasks, activeTaskId, activeStepId, running, defaultRunning, open, defaultOpen, activePanel, defaultActivePanel, onOpenChange, onTaskChange, onStepChange, onActivePanelChange, onStop, onStart, startActionId, fallbackFocusId, helpContent, children, delegateRestoration, startActionVisible }: TutorialPanelProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
/** One composition coordinator calls this only after an accepted Stop has rendered. */
export declare function restoreTutorialFocus(startActionId: string, fallbackFocusId?: string, openerId?: string): void;
